top_stories.title: Sukhpreet Singh and Ramandeep Kaur accused of hiding newborn’s remains in Canada, mother found in critical condition - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Halifax Regional Police** charged two relatives of the infant's mother with concealing the child's body and obstructing investigators after a newborn was found dead in wooded area near Halifax, Canada. The **infant's remains** were discovered on Sunday afternoon, prompting an investigation that began late Friday when hospital staff alerted police to a woman in critical condition who appeared to have recently given birth but without her baby.  The Nova Scotia Medical Examiner Service is expected to conduct an autopsy to determine the infant's identity and cause of death, while the woman remains hospitalized in critical condition.

top_stories.title: Assault on Youth Congress workers in Alappuzha: SIT says 'assault unlawful’ - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: A Special Investigation Team (SIT) concluded that the assault on Indian Youth Congress activists in Alappuzha by police officers, including those from former Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan's security detail, was unlawful. The SIT recommended criminal charges against the involved officers and found procedural irregularities in the initial investigation. **Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala** will review the report before forwarding it to the Home Secretary for further action.

top_stories.title: Deputy PM Dar to visit New York from May 26-28 for UN meetings - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Ishaq Dar**, Pakistan's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister, will travel to New York from Beijing on Tuesday to participate in UN meetings.  He is scheduled to attend the United Nations Security Council's open debate on international peace and security and a meeting of the Group of Friends on Global Governance, which includes **China** and **Pakistan**. The discussions focus on strengthening multilateralism and addressing global challenges.  Dar will also hold bilateral meetings with counterparts and UN officials during his time in New York.

top_stories.title: ‘A bridge, not an obstacle’: is Armenia a new crossroads between east and west? | Armenia | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: The upcoming national elections in Armenia are shaping up to be a crucial battleground as **Nikol Pashinyan** seeks re-election.  His campaign focuses on transforming Armenia into a strategic crossroads, connecting Europe and Asia through the "Real Armenia" doctrine. This involves securing peace with Azerbaijan, opening borders with Turkey and Azerbaijan, and potentially joining the EU. However, his plans face opposition from pro-Russian parties like **Samvel Karapetyan**'s Stronger Armenia, who accuse Pashinyan of betraying Armenia and prioritizing European interests over national sovereignty. The election is also marked by tensions surrounding the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict, with Azerbaijan demanding a constitutional amendment to remove any reference to Armenian independence claims.  The outcome will likely determine Armenia's future geopolitical direction and its relationship with Russia, Turkey, and the EU.

top_stories.title: Israel kills three in attacks on Lebanon, issues more displacement orders | News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Israel** carried out attacks on multiple villages and towns in southern Lebanon, killing at least three people. The **Israeli** military issued forced displacement orders for residents of 10 villages, citing Hezbollah's violation of the ceasefire agreement.  The attacks came despite a US-mediated ceasefire that took effect on April 17th and was later extended into early July.  Lebanese President Joseph Aoun stated that Israel’s withdrawal from Lebanon is a “non-negotiable” demand.

top_stories.title: 'You are not welcome': Row erupts after Laura Loomer says she wants to visit India again following Marco Rubio's trip - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Laura Loomer**, a far-right US political activist, sparked controversy after posting on X that she wants to return to India following **Marco Rubio’s** recent visit.  Loomer's comments drew criticism for her past controversial remarks about Indians and immigration, with users revisiting those posts. While Loomer previously criticized India and the H-1B visa program, she later praised India during her trip in March, calling it "incredible" and a potential future superpower. The controversy arose amidst **Rubio’s** first official visit to India as US Secretary of State, where he met with Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** and External Affairs Minister **S. Jaishankar**.

top_stories.title: Militants blow up govt school, basic health unit in KP's Tank - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Unidentified militants** detonated explosives at a government middle school and a basic health unit in the Chesan Kech area of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's Tank district late Sunday night. The attacks caused significant damage to both buildings, but no casualties were reported as they were empty at the time. **Police** and security personnel are investigating the incident and collecting evidence. This is not the first instance of militants targeting civil infrastructure in the region, with similar incidents occurring in Bannu, South Waziristan, and North Waziristan.

top_stories.title: Trump’s war loop: Escalate, retreat, repeat | TV Shows | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** is facing criticism from **US news outlets** for his declarations of victory in the US-Israel war against Iran, while **Iran** maintains its operational military and control over the Strait of Hormuz.  Experts warn that disruptions to global energy supplies could persist.

top_stories.title: Attacks on Congo health facilities trigger escape of Ebola patients, hamper response efforts | India News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Doctors** in the Democratic Republic of Congo are facing increasing challenges in combating the ongoing Ebola outbreak. Attacks on health facilities and fleeing patients have disrupted response efforts, particularly in Ituri province where the outbreak began. **Médecins Sans Frontières**, a medical charity, has reported that at least 18 patients escaped from Mongbwalu General Referral Hospital after attacks by unidentified individuals. The recent incidents are reminiscent of the 2018-2020 outbreak and have raised concerns about unsafe burials, which contribute to the spread of the virus. **The World Health Organization** has declared this outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, with over 900 suspected cases reported.

top_stories.title: India-China issues, impact of global conflicts, and the role of middle powers in spotlight at Huddle 2026 - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Hindu Huddle**, a conference in Bengaluru, will focus on geopolitical issues and the role of global powers.  **Chinese Ambassador to India Xu Feihong** will discuss India-China relations, while a panel titled “The Middle Power Way” will examine how middle powers can navigate the international order. **Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney**, who spoke at the World Economic Forum, will be referenced in this discussion alongside senior diplomats from **Australia, the European Union, Brazil, and India**.
